title: Bernalillo County launches 2026 'I Voted' sticker contest for APS students - ABQ Times
text:
The Bernalillo County Clerk announced on March 30 the launch of the 2026 “I Voted” Sticker Contest, inviting students from Albuquerque Public Schools to submit original artwork that promotes civic engagement and voting. The contest began on March 23 and gives students six weeks to create designs inspired by the theme, “Voting Is Your Superpower.”
This initiative aims to encourage young people to participate in democracy by allowing elementary, middle, and high school students from all subject areas—not just art classes—to enter. Submissions can be hand-drawn or digital but must be original work created without artificial intelligence tools.
Winning designs will be used as official “I Voted” stickers at polling locations throughout Bernalillo County during the 2026 General Election. Students have until May 1 to submit their entries. A panel made up of representatives from the Clerk’s Office and Albuquerque Public Schools will judge submissions in mid-May, selecting winners for each grade category. Winners will be notified before summer break and officially recognized at a Bernalillo County Commission meeting in September.
The contest is part of broader outreach efforts intended to foster lifelong participation in elections among young people.
Meanwhile, other issues affecting Bernalillo County have been reported recently. The District Attorney of Bernalillo County has raised concerns about suspects being released without GPS monitors when they are supposed to wear them according to KRQE. One example involved Jawid Yaqubi, who was accused of aggravated assault with a deadly weapon after allegedly firing a gun near his family members; despite efforts by the District Attorney’s office to keep him detained until trial, a judge decided he should be released.
For more information about participating in the sticker contest or for election details, residents can visit berncoclerk.gov or contact local officials as listed in the announcement.
